As Eaton Plc (ETN) Stock Price Rose, Shareholder Whalerock Point Partners Has Cut Holding; Chartist Holds Holding in Sempra Energy (SRE)
May 27, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Whalerock Point Partners Llc decreased its stake in Eaton Corp Plc (ETN) by 47.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Whalerock Point Partners Llc sold 5,575 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.84% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6,150 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $486,000, down from 11,725 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Whalerock Point Partners Llc who had been investing in Eaton Corp Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $34.23 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.81% or $0.64 during the last trading session, reaching $78.27. About 1.69 million shares traded. Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) has risen 9.67% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.88% the S&P500.
Chartist Inc increased its stake in Sempra Energy (SRE) by 33.3% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chartist Inc bought 964 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.65% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3,859 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $412.60M, up from 2,895 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chartist Inc who had been investing in Sempra Energy for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $27.79 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.02% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $105.19. About 1.48M shares traded. Sempra Energy (NYSE:SRE) has declined 0.38% since May 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 11.93% the S&P500.
Whalerock Point Partners Llc, which manages about $651.31 million and $315.86M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3,866 shares to 58,820 shares, valued at $9.96M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Cisco Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO) by 14,750 shares in the quarter, for a total of 58,030 shares, and has risen its stake in Pepsico Inc (NYSE:PEP).
Analysts await Eaton Corporation plc (NYSE:ETN) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $1.30 earnings per share, up 13.04% or $0.15 from last year’s $1.15 per share. ETN’s profit will be $568.48M for 15.05 P/E if the $1.30 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.10 actual earnings per share reported by Eaton Corporation plc for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 18.18% EPS growth.
